verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud runs the same GPL-3.0 open-source engine you can self-host for free, with the complete API surface available in the open-source server. That makes leaving the hosted service plausible without proprietary lock-in. However, the pack never documents an export endpoint or the formats data can be exported in; it only shows data being pushed in from CSV/JSON. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all documents/collections in open formats (e.g. JSONL), export of schemas/config/curation rules, a documented Cloud-to-self-host migration path, and independent hands-on corroboration of exiting.
